description: On phones the gallery on /app/gallery is used with the finger: swiping left shows the next slide, swiping right the previous one, a double tap likes the picture and a long press saves it to favourites.
acceptanceCriteria: Swiping left on Slide 1 of 3 shows Slide 2 of 3; swiping right goes back.
A long press shows Saved to favourites.
